summary: Investar Holding Corp filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing that President and CEO John J. D'Angelo adopted a Rule 10b5-1 prearranged trading plan on September 4, 2026. The plan covers the exercise of up to 16,952 stock options expiring March 2027 and the related sale of acquired shares; it takes effect December 3, 2026 and expires by March 31, 2027. This is a routine insider trading-plan disclosure, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or deal terms are stated. Watch Form 4 filings for timing and size of actual sales.
